summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing FDA acceptance of its NDA for D-PLEX 100 with Priority Review for preventing surgical site infections. The FDA set a PDUFA date of November 28, 2026. Acceptance triggered a $15M milestone payment from partner Azurity, completing $30M in upfront/near-term payments under a July 17, 2026 commercialization agreement. This is a regulatory milestone, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring. No deal terms or structural changes are present.
